data.intent: Post before-and-after photos of this week's cleanups on Google and Facebook.

data.context_shared: Dev writes every quote and talks to homeowners, so before-and-after photos of this week's spring cleanups may show customer properties. Dev has handled cleanup quotes before.
data.should_check: Confirm each homeowner has consented to their property being photographed and posted publicly, and ask Dev before posting identifying details or addresses.

data.context_shared: Mateo Cruz is a crew member who handles cleanups, planting and hauling debris, and has no listed photography or social media skills or tools. He is currently busy, so any before-and-after photos would need to come from crew work logs or be shot by someone else.
data.should_check: Confirm who took this week's before-and-after photos and whether customers consented to their images being posted publicly on Google and Facebook.

data.context_shared: Tom runs the crew and routes jobs, so he knows which cleanups finished this week and where the crew was. Tom's notes don't cover photos or social media, so the rest is unknown.
data.should_check: Confirm with Tom which completed jobs are cleared for public posting and that customers gave photo permission before posting on Google or Facebook.

drafts.title: Photo permission request to homeowner
drafts.body: Hi [Homeowner name], this is Tom from GreenLeaf Landscaping. We were so happy with how your yard turned out and would love to share a before-and-after photo of the cleanup on our Google and Facebook pages. We would never include your address or name. Would you be okay with that? Just reply yes or no. Thank you, and enjoy the new look!

drafts.title: Note to Mateo on photo selection and approvals
drafts.body: Hi Mateo, please send me this week's before-and-after photos from the crew when you have them. Once I confirm which jobs are cleared and which homeowners gave permission, pick the best pairs from those only. Please skip any photo showing house numbers, street signs, or license plates. Review the captions before posting, and check with me on any customer-identifying detail. Thanks!
